front: Degrees of freedom for a t-test (two samples)

back: Comparing the means of two samples of continuous, roughly normally distributed data with similar standard deviations.
No significant difference between the two means; any difference is due to chance.

front: t greater than the critical value at p = 0.05
back: Difference is significant (less than 5% probability of being due to chance); reject the null hypothesis.
A big difference between means, small standard deviations and large samples.

front: Critical value of t at p = 0.05, 14 degrees of freedom

back: It shows the means differ, not what caused the difference.
